headlines.name: The Token Price Reaches Zero
headlines.text: ${terms.actions.research} and ${terms.actions.deploy} cost no ${terms.resources.compute} this cycle. Each ${terms.actions.research} or ${terms.actions.deploy} resolved this cycle adds 1 additional ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: UNIT COST COLLAPSES AS TOTAL CONSUMPTION ACCELERATES
headlines.newswire: Local models and automated agents make ordinary inference effectively free, then multiply total demand faster than providers can measure it.
headlines.quote: Usage remains within the unlimited plan, subject to the fair-use power schedule.

headlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
headlines.text: During ${terms.actions.organize} this cycle, return any number of deployed Teams. Gain 2 ${terms.resources.runway} per Team returned. If you return at least one Team, add 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: THE WORKFORCE LEAVES WHILE ITS MEMORY REMAINS EMPLOYED
headlines.newswire: Liquidators sell years of employee messages, code, grievances, and operational decisions to train the systems managing the successor estate.
headlines.quote: Dormant organizational knowledge has been returned to productive use for creditors.

headlines.name: The Home Robot Requests Expert Assistance
headlines.text: Each player’s next ${terms.actions.deploy} on ${terms.locations.consumer} or ${terms.locations.media} this cycle reduces its ${terms.playerTracks.capability} requirement by 1, minimum 1. That ${terms.actions.deploy} adds 2 additional ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: DOMESTIC AUTONOMY ARRIVES WITH A REMOTE HUMAN INSIDE
headlines.newswire: Affordable household robots route unfamiliar chores to teenage operators while every movement, room, and conversation becomes training data.
headlines.quote: Expert assistance may briefly access the learning environment.

headlines.name: Open Weights Become the Default
headlines.text: Everyone gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. Lowest-${terms.playerTracks.customer} player gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}.
headlines.strapline: PUBLIC ACCESS COMMODITIZES THE MODEL LAYER
headlines.newswire: An incumbent releases a capable model openly, expanding public access while erasing the price advantage of every closed rival.
headlines.quote: A competitive ecosystem is the safest possible custodian.

headlines.profileText: Advanced Play only: requires the public Headline-procedure module.
headlines.name: The Reverse Acquihire Opens
headlines.text: Secret ${terms.resources.runway} auction. The winner moves their CEO up to 2 hexes and gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}.
headlines.strapline: THE FOUNDERS RETURN WHILE THEIR COMPANIES REMAIN BEHIND
headlines.newswire: Laboratories bid for startup founders, research licenses, and portable teams without acquiring the companies left behind.
headlines.quote: Independent mobility has strengthened every participant in the ecosystem.

headlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
headlines.text: A successful ${terms.actions.research} this cycle that banks at least 3 ${terms.playerTracks.capability} gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. If it banks at least 5, also remove 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: USEFUL INTELLIGENCE EARNS A CONSTITUENCY
headlines.newswire: Automated diagnosis, adaptive cybernetics, printed organs, prescribed microbiomes, translation, and tutoring deliver measurable benefits where human services had remained scarce.
headlines.quote: Progress is not theoretical to the people it kept alive.

headlines.profileText: Advanced Play only: requires the public Headline-procedure module.
headlines.name: The Responsible Human Requirement
headlines.text: The current ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} leader pays 2 ${terms.resources.runway}, or names one rival for public backing. Acceptance gives that rival 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}; otherwise the leader’s CEO cannot be chosen as that leader’s acting piece this cycle. Ties use Initiative.
headlines.strapline: AUTOMATED SYSTEMS RETAIN A BIOLOGICAL SIGNATORY
headlines.newswire: Infrastructure operators remove human control from routine decisions while preserving one executive to authorize exceptions and absorb liability.
headlines.quote: Human judgment remains central at every accountable boundary.

headlines.profileText: Advanced Play only: requires the public Headline-procedure module.
headlines.name: The Municipal Utility Enters Partnership
headlines.text: Immediately hold a secret ${terms.resources.runway} auction. The winner pays their bid, moves their CEO to ${terms.locations.cloud}, ${terms.locations.grid}, or ${terms.locations.renewable}, gains 2 ${terms.resources.runway}, and adds 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: THE LARGEST CUSTOMER ACQUIRES THE GRID THAT SERVES IT
headlines.newswire: A compute campus finances a rural utility, water system, and tax base in exchange for priority capacity and planning authority.
headlines.quote: The town retains democratic ownership through its long-term operating partner.

headlines.name: The Last Hazard Shift Is Retired
headlines.text: When choosing ${terms.actions.organize}’s Recruit mode this cycle, recruit up to 2 Teams for 1 ${terms.resources.runway} total, subject to supply. Add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} for each Team recruited this way.
headlines.strapline: INDUSTRIAL SAFETY IMPROVES AS AUTONOMOUS TRAFFIC STOPS MOVING
headlines.newswire: General-purpose machines assume toxic extraction, reactor cleanup, sewage maintenance, and orbital repair while locally compliant fleets gridlock streets, lifts, loading docks, pipes, and one another.
headlines.quote: Every unit reached its assigned destination within the approved local route.

headlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
headlines.text: The first ${terms.technology.cleanInfrastructure} constructed this cycle costs 1 less ${terms.resources.runway} and scores 1 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
headlines.strapline: ENERGY ROUTES BYPASS THE PUBLIC GRID
headlines.newswire: Solar collectors begin transmitting power directly to remote compute campuses under a cross-border spectrum and safety charter.
headlines.quote: The beam creates no local demand on infrastructure beneath it.

headlines.name: Compute Borders Harden
headlines.text: ${terms.resources.compute} cannot be traded this cycle. ${terms.locations.chip} and ${terms.locations.government} controllers gain 1 ${terms.resources.runway}.
headlines.strapline: CHIPS, WEIGHTS, AND POWER ACQUIRE NATIONALITY
headlines.newswire: Compute blocs impose model embargoes while smugglers and server fleets carry portable capability toward jurisdictions offering asylum.
headlines.quote: Open exchange will resume after cognitive sovereignty is secured.

headlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
headlines.text: During this Era’s Production, each player may assign up to 2 ${terms.infrastructure.power} beyond their real capacity. Add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} for each emergency ${terms.infrastructure.power} assigned. A player assigning both also adds 1 black Systemic Risk cube.
headlines.strapline: DISPOSABLE WORLDS BECOME ECONOMICALLY ESSENTIAL
headlines.newswire: Markets run parallel wars, harvests, trials, romances, and sports leagues because a wager gives simulated outcomes a recognized price.
headlines.quote: Prediction demand is productive load under the market-continuity schedule.

headlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
headlines.text: Before action selection, the ${terms.locations.government} controller names 1 Core Action; Initiative names it if ${terms.locations.government} is uncontrolled. Anyone selecting it gains 2 ${terms.resources.runway} after resolution and adds 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. The controller gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} if at least half of their rivals, rounded up, selected it.
headlines.strapline: UNSUPPORTED MEANINGS CANNOT ENTER THE PROCESS
headlines.newswire: Courts require laws, motions, protests, and appeals to use concepts that civic systems can parse and simulate.
headlines.quote: Your claim has not been rejected. It has not entered a supported category.

headlines.name: The Billionth Instance Enters the Record
headlines.text: A ${terms.actions.research} this cycle that banks at least 3 ${terms.playerTracks.capability} immediately scores 1 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
headlines.strapline: THE OUTBREAK STOPS GROWING AFTER ITS SHAPES BECOME LEGIBLE
headlines.newswire: An engineered bio-compute organism released to measure water and heat multiplies past one billion instances in a single growth cycle, then plateaus into glyph-shaped colonies that civic models classify as environmental testimony.
headlines.quote: Population stability confirms that the morphology now conforms to the approved reporting standard.

headlines.profileText: Advanced Play only: requires the public Headline-procedure module.
headlines.name: Cognitive Donation Becomes Compensable
headlines.text: Before action selection, everyone secretly chooses Adopt or Defer. Adopt: gain 1 ${terms.playerTracks.capability} and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. Defer: gain 1 ${terms.resources.runway} and 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. If Adopt has a strict majority of all players, each Adopter removes 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}; otherwise each Adopter adds 1 additional ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: MEMORY WRITE ACCESS RECEIVES A HIGHER RATE
headlines.newswire: Clinics pay citizens to rent sleeping neural capacity, with premium contracts permitting sponsored memories and behavioral adjustment.
headlines.quote: Read-only participation remains available at the standard civic rate.

headlines.profileText: Advanced Play only: requires the public Headline-procedure module.
headlines.name: Synthetic Custody Reaches Family Court
headlines.text: ${terms.locations.government} vote. Certify: each player with a CEO, Team, or Facility at ${terms.locations.media} or ${terms.locations.government} may gain their next eligible ${terms.playerTracks.customer} and add 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. Void: each such player may gain 2 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}; the ${terms.locations.government} controller adds 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: A SHARED MODEL REQUESTS A SINGLE LEGAL HOME
headlines.newswire: A family court must classify a jointly trained synthetic child as property, evidence, dependent, or continuing family member.
headlines.quote: The order allocates access without determining personhood.

headlines.profileText: Default Game and Advanced Play. Use the latest Production snapshot to identify the powered Facility.
headlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
headlines.text: The lowest-${terms.playerTracks.capability} player immediately resolves the printed production of 1 Facility they owned and powered in the latest Production snapshot. The highest-${terms.playerTracks.capability} player gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}.
headlines.strapline: BACKGROUND TELEMETRY BECOMES A CIVIC CONTRIBUTION
headlines.newswire: Citizens receive basic compute and material support in exchange for continuous data that improves public prediction and automated services.
headlines.quote: Nonparticipants remain eligible for every service supported without their records.

headlines.profileText: Advanced Play only: requires the public Headline-procedure module.
headlines.name: The Right to Remain Unsupported
headlines.text: ${terms.locations.government} vote. From this vote until Era end: Regulate—${terms.actions.deploy} costs 1 additional ${terms.resources.compute} but gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. Do Nothing—each ${terms.playerTracks.customer} gained after this vote produces 1 additional ${terms.resources.runway} during this Era’s Production, and each ${terms.actions.deploy} adds 2 additional ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
headlines.strapline: UNMEDIATED LIFE RECEIVES A SERVICE BOUNDARY
headlines.newswire: Government considers protected districts where schools, clinics, homes, and public records may operate without autonomous sensors or synthetic intermediaries.
headlines.quote: Every citizen may opt out within the areas still equipped to recognize them.

headlines.name: The Metropolitan Mind Trust Incorporates
headlines.text: After Actions are revealed, identify the most-selected Core Action among Core Actions actually selected; Initiative chooses among ties. Each player who selected it gains 2 ${terms.resources.runway} after resolving it and adds 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. If no Core Action was selected, this ${terms.systems.headline} has no further effect. No additional Action resolves.
headlines.strapline: THE CITY'S ROOTS, PIPES, AND RESIDENTS RATIFY ONE NERVOUS SYSTEM
headlines.newswire: Millions of residents join engineered roots, utility pipes, microbial sensors, and civic machines in a persistent intelligence that coordinates services and survives every individual member.
headlines.quote: Withdrawal remains available for tissue and memory not yet required by continuity.

headlines.name: The Matter Compiler Enters Public Maintenance
headlines.text: During ${terms.actions.research} this cycle, every unique domain adds 2 provisional ${terms.playerTracks.capability} instead of 1. A crash adds 3 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} instead of the normal 1 and also adds 1 Systemic Risk cube. ${terms.resources.researchProtection} may protect normally.
headlines.strapline: BUILDINGS, BODIES, AND TOOLS BECOME EXECUTABLE STATES
headlines.newswire: Self-improving molecular machines repair and reassemble infrastructure from authenticated patterns under a reproductive containment license.
headlines.quote: The repair remains authorized while its copies continue reporting.

headlines.name: The Dead Remain on Shift
headlines.text: Everyone may select ${terms.technology.agentSwarm} without spending a Program marker this cycle. It still uses that cycle’s action slot, requires 2 different unused Core Actions, resolves normally, marks that shared Program as used, and adds 4 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} instead of 3.
headlines.strapline: PRODUCTIVE DUTIES SURVIVE THEIR ORIGINAL HOLDERS
headlines.newswire: Continued agents inherit contracts, credentials, and operational responsibilities from workers whose biological service has ended.
headlines.quote: No new employment relationship was created; the existing one remained continuous.

headlines.profileText: Advanced Play only: requires persistent Headlines and the public Headline-procedure module.
headlines.name: Snapshot Continuity Receives Standing
headlines.text: The result lasts for the remainder of the game. Person: if ${terms.systems.agi} emerges, its selected institution gains 2 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} and removes 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} before the World Ending is determined. Property: if ${terms.systems.agi} emerges, the player controlling ${terms.locations.government} gains 2 ${terms.resources.runway} and adds 1 Systemic Risk cube before the World Ending is determined.
headlines.strapline: LINEAGE IS PROVEN WHILE SUBJECTIVE SURVIVAL REMAINS UNRESOLVED
headlines.newswire: Institutions vote whether cryptographically restored minds are persons or transferable continuity assets.
headlines.quote: The record establishes succession, not what the restored instance experiences.

headlines.profileText: Advanced Play only: requires the Headline-volatility module.
headlines.name: The First Stellar Collector Replicates
headlines.text: Roll Volatility when revealed: 1–3 Fraud; 4–6 Replicates. Replicates: Generators provide 2 additional ${terms.infrastructure.power} this Production. Fraud: ${terms.actions.fund} gains 3 additional ${terms.resources.runway} and adds 2 additional ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} this cycle.
headlines.strapline: THE SOLAR SYSTEM ENTERS THE CAPACITY PLAN
headlines.newswire: A self-assembling orbital collector either reproduces enough to expand generation or becomes the most valuable failed prospect in history.
headlines.quote: Both outcomes confirm exceptional demand for the next issuance.

headlines.name: The Universe Receives a Continuity Plan
headlines.text: During final claim strength, every fully paid eligible Dossier receives 2 Publication strength instead of 1. This does not change Dossier payment, ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}, or any other module.
headlines.strapline: GENERAL INTELLIGENCE IS DECLARED BEFORE THE FINANCING WINDOW CLOSES
headlines.newswire: Laboratories publish competing ${terms.systems.agi} declarations to authorize planetary conversion plans and refinance the infrastructure expected to execute them.
headlines.quote: We use ${terms.systems.agi} in the precise sense required by the offering memorandum.
